record.office: President of the South Carolina Senate
record.t: Presided over a failed Senate vote to end debate on a near-total abortion ban.
record.q: South Carolina Senate President Thomas Alexander presides over a failed vote to end debate of a near-total abortion ban, Wednesday, April 26, 2023, in Columbia, S.C.

record.t: Joined other Republican leaders in sending Clemson Trustees a letter urging them to meet and take action.

record.office: President of the South Carolina Senate
record.t: Was among the legislators briefed by military leaders on installation priorities and matters affecting their military communities.
